title: Governance rules
description: Guards that keep agents inside their task: protected files, suppressions, tests, dependencies, scope, lockfiles, snapshots and declared imports.

rules.title: Protected oracle or configuration changed by an agent run
rules.message: A protected oracle or configuration file changed during this unit.
rules.fix: Revert the change, or ask a human to review it and approve it with /frontsmith:approve <feature> config.
rules.rationale: References, tolerances, contracts, packs, waivers and configuration are the oracles the gates trust; an agent must not edit them.

rules.title: New inline suppression without reason or on a non-suppressible rule
rules.message: A new suppression comment has no valid reason or targets a rule that cannot be suppressed.
rules.fix: Remove the comment and fix the finding, or ask a human for a waiver.
rules.rationale: Suppressions are only honoured for minor and nit rules marked suppressible, with a written reason.

rules.title: Tests weakened by an agent run
rules.message: A test was deleted, lost assertions, was skipped or focused, or a coverage threshold was lowered.
rules.fix: Restore the test or coverage threshold and fix the code instead.
rules.rationale: Weakening tests is the cheapest way to turn a gate green, so it is checked deterministically.

rules.title: Dependency or script change without approval
rules.message: A dependency or package script changed without a recorded approval.
rules.fix: Approve the dependency with /frontsmith:approve <feature> dependency <name>, or remove it.
rules.rationale: New dependencies and changed scripts widen what gates execute and what ships.

rules.title: Change outside the task scope
rules.message: The unit changed a file that its task contract does not cover.
rules.fix: Revert the unrelated change, or ask for a new task that names the file.
rules.rationale: Opportunistic edits grow the diff, the risk and the review load without serving the acceptance criteria.

rules.title: Lockfile changed without manifest change
rules.message: A lockfile changed but no package.json did.
rules.fix: Revert the lockfile change, or explain the manifest change that justifies it.
rules.rationale: A lockfile that moves on its own usually means an accidental install or upgrade.

rules.title: Snapshot or baseline files changed during implementation
rules.message: A snapshot or visual baseline changed during implementation.
rules.fix: Revert it; baselines are approved by a human with /frontsmith:baseline approve.
rules.rationale: Updating snapshots during a build turns a failing check into a passing one without evidence.

rules.title: Import of a package not declared in package.json
rules.message: The file imports a package that package.json does not declare.
rules.fix: Use an installed package, or add the dependency and have a human approve it.
rules.rationale: Agents sometimes import libraries that are not installed; the build then fails or hides a half-written substitute.
